job.title: Cyber Security Awareness Specialist
job.description:
Senior Security Awareness Specialist

About the opportunity

Cyber risk is as much a people challenge as a technology one, and this role sits right at that intersection. You'll join the cyber security function of one of Australia's largest ASX-listed consumer businesses, helping shape a security culture across a large and complex enterprise. This is a hands-on, high-visibility role where your campaigns, training and relationships directly change how thousands of people think about and respond to cyber risk.

The role
  • Design and deliver engaging security awareness, communication and training programs that educate, influence and engage team members across the business
  • Plan and run a year-round campaign calendar, including targeted phishing simulations, and measure and report on results
  • Partner with developers and technical teams to promote secure coding practices and embed security into the development lifecycle
  • Work with senior leaders, IT, digital and communications teams to shape security policies, standards and key messaging
  • Build and grow a network of Security Awareness champions across the organisation
What you'll bring
  • 3+ years of experience in organisational learning and change management, with a track record of creating training and engagement programs for diverse audiences
  • 3+ years of experience in IT or cyber security roles, with a solid grasp of core security concepts, application security, cloud and web architectures
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication, able to translate security concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Strong stakeholder skills, with the ability to build relationships, negotiate and influence at all levels
  • Project management experience, comfortable planning and running a complex, ongoing program and reporting on metrics
Nice to have: familiarity with application development processes, and knowledge of frameworks such as NIST and CIS.

Culture
  • Reports into the head of Cyber Business partnering and engagement, working closely with the wider cyber security team
  • A collaborative environment, with day-to-day partnership across security, IT, digital and development teams, and communications
  • Values-led: the team cares about its people, listens and learns, and puts integrity first
What's on offer
  • The chance to run a genuinely enterprise-wide awareness program, not just a tick-box exercise
  • A career pathway into wider cyber security or organisational change roles
How to apply

If you're passionate about changing behaviour and building a strong security culture, we'd love to hear from you.

Click Apply now with your CV, or contact Emily at PRA for a confidential chat about the role.

PRA is a leading Digital & IT Recruitment company with offices in Brisbane, Sydney, Canberra and Melbourne.

job.title: Pen Tester / SOC Analyst
job.description:
About the opportunity

Our client is looking for a security professional who doesn't want to choose between offence and defence. Sitting within its cyber security operations team, this role splits time roughly evenly between authorised penetration testing and Security Operations Centre work.

What makes it different is the feedback loop. The weaknesses you find in testing don't just go into a report; you'll map them to MITRE ATT&CK and use them to validate and improve the telemetry, detections and playbooks the SOC relies on every day. It's a complex, multi-platform environment with a strong Microsoft identity footprint, offering real breadth across applications, infrastructure, identity and cloud.

The role
  • Plan and deliver authorised penetration tests across web apps, APIs, infrastructure, identity services and cloud platforms, under defined Rules of Engagement
  • Monitor and triage alerts across SIEM, EDR and XDR platforms, investigating and escalating confirmed incidents
  • Develop, tune and validate detection rules, use cases, dashboards and response playbooks
  • Run proactive threat hunts using telemetry, threat intelligence and known adversary behaviour
  • Report findings with evidence, risk ratings, remediation advice and re-test outcomes
What you'll bring
  • Proven experience in both penetration testing and security operations within complex enterprise environments
  • Hands-on SIEM, EDR or XDR experience, including triage, incident analysis and escalation
  • Detection engineering experience using KQL, SPL, Sigma or equivalent, and a strong grasp of MITRE ATT&CK
  • Solid knowledge of Active Directory, Entra ID, Microsoft 365, Windows and Linux security
  • A relevant tertiary qualification and current industry security accreditation
Recognised pen testing, SOC, incident response or cloud security certifications are highly regarded, as is Agile delivery experience.

Culture
  • Close collaboration with security engineering, infrastructure, cloud, application, identity, architecture and risk teams
  • A disciplined approach: controlled testing in production under change, escalation and safety requirements
  • An individual contributor role with genuine breadth rather than a narrow specialism
If this sounds like you please apply for the role right away!
